claims.text: Jev Review scans Git diffs or complete codebases for correctness, security, reliability, compatibility and test coverage.

evidence.quote: A small code-review workflow built with [TypeSafe Jev](https://typesafe.ai). It can review a Git diff or scan a complete codebase, follows the strongest structured signals through focused model calls, and presents the result in a quiet local dashboard.

- Exposes separate change-review and complete-codebase entry points.
- Uses changed or related tests as context when judging test gaps.
- Screens correctness, security, reliability, compatibility, and test coverage.
- Selects concrete diff hunks or source regions before scoring impact.
- Uses structured hints, counterexamples, and explicit decision boundaries.
- Applies thresholds and workflow policy in code.
- Shows large reports in collapsible dashboard sections.
- Binds the dashboard to `127.0.0.1` and never serves environment files.

claims.text: Jev selects evidence, classifies mechanisms, scores severity and, when needed, uses Choice to select a reviewer. Code applies thresholds and workflow policy.

evidence.quote:
The reviewer keeps orchestration in code and uses Jev for bounded judgments:

```text
Noul risk matrix
  -> Choice + Score file profiles
  -> Choice evidence selection
  -> Choice mechanism classification
  -> Score severity
  -> conditional Choice reviewer routing
```

- Exposes separate change-review and complete-codebase entry points.
- Uses changed or related tests as context when judging test gaps.
- Screens correctness, security, reliability, compatibility, and test coverage.
- Selects concrete diff hunks or source regions before scoring impact.
- Uses structured hints, counterexamples, and explicit decision boundaries.
- Applies thresholds and workflow policy in code.

claims.text: Use Node.js 24+, Git and a TypeSafe key to generate JSON reports or inspect saved reviews locally.

evidence.quote:
Requires Node.js 24+, Git, and a [TypeSafe API key](https://console.typesafe.ai/settings/keys).

```bash
npm install
cp .env.example .env
# Add TYPESAFE_API_KEY to .env

# Review the current Git diff
npm run review:changes:save -- /path/to/git/repository

# Or scan every non-ignored source file under a scope
npm run review:codebase:save -- /path/to/git/repository-or-package
npm run dashboard

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run review:changes -- <path>` | Print a current-diff review as JSON |
| `npm run review:changes:save -- <path>` | Save a current-diff review for the dashboard |
| `npm run review:codebase -- <path>` | Print a complete codebase scan as JSON |
| `npm run review:codebase:save -- <path>` | Save a complete codebase scan for the dashboard |
| `npm run dashboard` | Start the local dashboard |

claims.text: This experiment lacks compiler and static-analysis integration. Findings prompt review and do not prove defects.

evidence.quote:
## Current Scope

This is an experiment in composing fast typed judgments into a review workflow. It does not yet integrate compiler diagnostics, static analyzers, repository indexing, or generated explanations. Findings are review prompts, not proof of a defect.

vi.description: Jev Review kết hợp phán đoán Jev để rà soát diff hay toàn bộ mã, chọn bằng chứng và mức nghiêm trọng cho báo cáo cục bộ cần kiểm chứng.
vi.summary: Jev Review quét diff Git hoặc toàn bộ mã để xét tính đúng, bảo mật, tin cậy, tương thích và độ phủ kiểm thử. Jev chọn bằng chứng, phân loại cơ chế và chấm mức nghiêm trọng; khi đủ điều kiện, dùng Choice chọn bên rà soát. Mã áp dụng ngưỡng và chính sách quy trình. Dùng Node.js 24+, Git và khóa TypeSafe để xuất JSON hoặc xem bản rà soát đã lưu cục bộ.

sections.text: Thử nghiệm chưa tích hợp trình biên dịch hay phân tích tĩnh. Phát hiện là gợi ý rà soát, không chứng minh lỗi.

tr.title: Jev Review: kod incelemesi için türlenmiş yargılar
tr.h1: Jev Review: kod incelemesi için türlenmiş yargılar
tr.description: Jev Review, Jev yargılarıyla Git farklarını veya kodu inceleyip yerel rapora kanıt ve önem derecesi seçer. Bulgular ayrıca incelenmelidir.
tr.summary: Jev Review Git farklarını veya tüm kodu doğruluk, güvenlik, güvenilirlik, uyumluluk ve test kapsamı açısından tarar. Jev kanıt seçer, mekanizmaları sınıflandırır, önem derecesini puanlar ve koşullar sağlandığında Choice ile inceleyiciyi seçer. Kod eşikleri ve iş akışı politikasını uygular. Node.js 24+, Git ve TypeSafe anahtarıyla JSON raporu oluşturun veya kayıtlı incelemeleri yerelde görüntüleyin.

it.title: Jev Review: giudizi tipizzati per revisionare codice
it.h1: Jev Review: giudizi tipizzati per revisionare codice
it.description: Jev Review combina giudizi Jev per esaminare diff o intere basi di codice, con prove e gravità nei rapporti locali; i risultati vanno verificati.
it.summary: Jev Review esamina diff Git o intere basi di codice per correttezza, sicurezza, affidabilità, compatibilità e copertura dei test. Jev seleziona prove, classifica meccanismi e valuta la gravità; quando previsto dal flusso, sceglie anche il revisore tramite Choice. Il codice applica soglie e regole del processo. Usa Node.js 24+, Git e una chiave TypeSafe per generare JSON o consultare revisioni salvate localmente.

sections.heading: A cosa serve
sections.text: Jev Review esamina diff Git o intere basi di codice per correttezza, sicurezza, affidabilità, compatibilità e copertura dei test.

sections.heading: Il ruolo di Jev
sections.text: Jev seleziona prove, classifica meccanismi e valuta la gravità; quando previsto dal flusso, sceglie anche il revisore tramite Choice. Il codice applica soglie e regole del processo.

sections.heading: Come usarlo
sections.text: Usa Node.js 24+, Git e una chiave TypeSafe per generare JSON o consultare revisioni salvate localmente.

sections.heading: Limiti
sections.text: L’esperimento non integra compilatori o analisi statica. I risultati suggeriscono verifiche, senza dimostrare difetti.
